name: handwritten notes type over a blurred interface
looks: Small sticky-note style cards, each tilted a few degrees, sit over a softly blurred dark interface in the background. Inside each note, a short instruction types on character by character in a casual handwritten face with a blinking cursor -- a style rule, a type rule -- one note at a time.
build: DOM note cards at slight seeded rotations; text revealed per character at a steady rate in a marker/handwritten face with a blinking cursor; the interface behind sits out of focus the whole shot, swapped only between notes.
sound: A light typing clack per character, softer than a body-copy type-on.
prompt: Open on a couple of small, slightly tilted note cards floating over a softly blurred product interface, each one typing on a short instruction in a casual handwritten face with a blinking cursor -- read as a founder or designer jotting quick style notes before the real interface comes into focus.
